BusinessYear.definition: Year for which plan provides coverage to enrollees

StateCode.definition: Two-character state abbreviation indicating the state where the plan is offered

IssuerId.definition: Five-digit numeric code that identifies the issuer organization in the Health Insurance Oversight System (HIOS)

SourceName.definition: Categorical identifier of source of data import

VersionNum.definition: Integer value for version of data import
VersionNum.comments: This field is only available for the 2014 through 2016 datasets.

IssuerId2.definition: Five-digit numeric code that identifies the issuer organization in HIOS
IssuerId2.comments: This field is only available for the 2014 through 2016 datasets.

FederalTIN.comments: This field is only available for the 2014 through 2020 datasets.

RateEffectiveDate.definition: Date that the insurance plan rate is effective

RateExpirationDate.definition: Date that the insurance plan rate expires

PlanId.definition: Fourteen-character alpha-numeric code that identifies an insurance plan within HIOS

RatingAreaId.definition: Identifier for the geographic rating area within a state
RatingAreaId.comments: Each rating area identifier maps to a geographic region within the state (e.g., one or more counties, three-digit zip codes, or metropolitan statistical areas).

Tobacco.definition: Indicator of whether a rate is based on a subscriber's tobacco use

Age.definition: Indicator of whether a rate is based on a subscriber’s age, or uses family-tier rating
Age.comments: If a rate is based on a subscriber’s age, the age band associated with the rate is reported. If a rate uses family-tier rating, a value of Family Option is reported.

IndividualRate.definition: Insurance rate applied to an individual in a rating area
IndividualRate.comments: If a plan rates by a subscriber’s age and tobacco use, the rate applies to a non-tobacco user. If a plan rates by family-tier, the rate applies to the primary subscriber.

IndividualTobaccoRate.definition: Insurance rate applied to a tobacco user in a rating area, for a plan that rates by a subscriber’s age
IndividualTobaccoRate.comments: This field is only applicable if Tobacco field equals Tobacco User/Non-Tobacco User.

Couple.definition: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber and secondary subscriber (e.g., spouse) in a rating area, for a plan that rates by family-tier
Couple.comments: This field is only applicable if Age field equals Family Option.

PrimarySubscriberAndOneDependent.definition: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber and one dependent in a rating area, for a plan that rates by family-tier
PrimarySubscriberAndOneDependent.comments: This field is only applicable if Age field equals Family Option.

PrimarySubscriberAndTwoDependents.definition: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber and two dependents in a rating area, for a plan that rates by family-tier
PrimarySubscriberAndTwoDependents.comments: This field is only applicable if Age field equals Family Option.

PrimarySubscriberAndThreeOrMoreDependent.definition: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber and three or more dependents in a rating area, for a plan that rates by family-tier
PrimarySubscriberAndThreeOrMoreDependent.comments: This field is only applicable if Age field equals Family Option.

CoupleAndOneDependent.definition: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber and secondary subscriber (e.g., spouse) and one dependent in a rating area, for a plan that rates by family-tier
CoupleAndOneDependent.comments: This field is only applicable if Age field equals Family Option.

CoupleAndTwoDependents.definition: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber and secondary subscriber (e.g., spouse) and two dependents in a rating area, for a plan that rates by family-tier
CoupleAndTwoDependents.comments: This field is only applicable if Age field equals Family Option.

CoupleAndThreeOrMoreDependents.definition: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber and secondary subscriber (e.g., spouse) and three or more dependents in a rating area, for a plan that rates by family-tier
CoupleAndThreeOrMoreDependents.comments: This field is only applicable if Age field equals Family Option.

RowNumber.definition: Integer value for template row number associated with this data record
RowNumber.comments: This field is only available for the 2014 through 2016 datasets.

BusinessYear.definition: Year for which plan provides coverage to enrollees

StateCode.definition: Two-character state abbreviation indicating the state where the plan is offered

IssuerId.definition: Five-digit numeric code that identifies the issuer organization in the Health Insurance Oversight System (HIOS)

IssuerMarketplaceMarketingName.definition: Marketplace Marketing name of insurance company
IssuerMarketplaceMarketingName.comments: This field is only available for the 2021 through 2027 datasets.

SourceName.definition: Categorical identifier of source of data import

VersionNum.definition: Integer value for version of data import
VersionNum.comments: This field is only available for the 2014 through 2016 datasets.

BenefitPackageId.comments: This field is only available for the 2014 through 2016 datasets.

IssuerId2.comments: This field is only available for the 2014 through 2016 datasets.

StateCode2.definition: Two-character state abbreviation indicating the state where the plan is offered
StateCode2.comments: This field is only available for the 2014 through 2016 datasets.

MarketCoverage.definition: Categorical indicator of market coverage of plan

DentalOnlyPlan.definition: Categorical indicator of dental-only status of plan

TIN.comments: This field is only available for the 2014 through 2020 datasets.

StandardComponentId.definition: Fourteen-character alpha-numeric code that identifies an insurance plan within HIOS

HIOSProductId.definition: Seven-character alpha-numeric code that identifies an insurance product within HIOS

HPID.definition: Identifies the insurance product using a National Health Plan Identifier
HPID.comments: This field is only available for the 2014 through 2020 datasets.

NetworkId.definition: Identifier for a health care provider network
NetworkId.comments: Network IDs can be imported from the issuer’s Network ID template, or entered manually by issuer.

ServiceAreaId.comments: Service Area IDs can be imported from the issuer’s Service Area template, or entered manually by issuer.

FormularyId.comments: Formulary IDs can be imported from the issuer’s Prescription Drug template, or entered manually by issuer; this field is not applicable to dental plans.

IsNewPlan.definition: Categorical indicator of whether the insurance plan is new for the current year or existed previously in the Marketplace

MetalLevel.definition: Metal level, or coverage category, of insurance plan based on its actuarial value
MetalLevel.comments: Values of High and Low are only applicable to dental plans; values other than High and Low are only applicable only to medical plans.

DesignType.definition: An indication of whether a plan is a Standardized Plan Option for its metal level, plan type and service area
DesignType.comments: This field is available for the 2017 through 2020 datasets as an indicator of whether a plan has a Standardized Plan Design, as indicated by Design Types 1 through 5; there are no further definitions of these Design Type values. This field is also available for the 2023 through 2027 datasets as an indicator of whether a plan is a Standardized Plan Option. The Allowable Values defined above are applicable to Plan Years 2023 through 2027. This field is not applicable to dental plans.

UniquePlanDesign.definition: An indication that the health insurance plan has a unique design, for purposes of the Actuarial Value calculator
UniquePlanDesign.comments: This field is not applicable to dental plans.

QHPNonQHPTypeId.definition: Categorical indicator of a plan’s Exchange status (On the Exchange, Off the Exchange)

IsNoticeRequiredForPregnancy.definition: An indication of whether notice to the issuer is required before pregnancy-related benefits will be covered
IsNoticeRequiredForPregnancy.comments: This field is not applicable to dental plans.

IsReferralRequiredForSpecialist.definition: An indication of whether pre-authorization is required before a specialist visit
IsReferralRequiredForSpecialist.comments: This field is not applicable to dental plans.

SpecialistRequiringReferral.definition: The types of specialists that require pre-authorization
SpecialistRequiringReferral.comments: This field is not applicable to dental plans; this field is only required if IsReferralRequiredForSpecialist field equals Yes.

PlanLevelExclusions.comments: This field is optional; blanks indicate a value was not provided.

IndianPlanVariationEstimatedAdvancedPaym.definition: Estimated dollar amount of cost–sharing reductions for eligible enrollees to be provided in the form of an advance payment to the issuer
IndianPlanVariationEstimatedAdvancedPaym.comments: This field is not applicable to dental plans; this field should be blank for medical plans.

CompositeRatingOffered.definition: An indication of whether the plan uses composite premiums.
CompositeRatingOffered.comments: This field is only available for the 2016 through 2027 datasets. This field equals “No” for individual market plans.

ChildOnlyOffering.definition: The types of adult and child enrollment options (Allows Adult and Child-only, Allows Adult-only, Allows Child-only) of an insurance plan
ChildOnlyOffering.comments: This field is not applicable to catastrophic plans.

ChildOnlyPlanId.definition: The HIOS Plan Identifier for the child-only insurance plan that corresponds to the adult-only insurance plan
ChildOnlyPlanId.comments: This field is only applicable to adult-only plans and does not apply to catastrophic plans.

WellnessProgramOffered.definition: An indication of whether an insurance plan offers wellness programs according to Section 2705 of the Public Health Service Act
WellnessProgramOffered.comments: This field is not applicable to dental plans.

DiseaseManagementProgramsOffered.definition: Categorical indicator of whether the plan offers disease management programs for specific conditions
DiseaseManagementProgramsOffered.comments: This field is not applicable to dental plans.

EHBPercentTotalPremium.definition: The percent of the plan’s total premium associated with coverage of Essential Health Benefit (EHB) services
EHBPercentTotalPremium.comments: This field is only available for the 2016 through 2027 datasets. This field is only valid for medical plans and is not required for catastrophic plans.

EHBPercentPremiumS4.definition: The projected percent of the plan’s total premium relative to the EHB benchmark plan for the state.
EHBPercentPremiumS4.comments: This field is only available for the 2014 and 2015 datasets. This field is only valid for medical plans.

EHBPediatricDentalApportionmentQuantity.definition: The dollar amount or percentage of the EHB Apportionment for Pediatric Dental
EHBPediatricDentalApportionmentQuantity.comments: This field is not applicable to medical plans. This field is a dollar amount for the 2014 through 2016 datasets, and is a percentage for the 2017 through 2027 datasets.

IsGuaranteedRate.definition: An indication of whether the rates for the insurance plan are guaranteed or estimated
IsGuaranteedRate.comments: This field is not applicable to medical plans.

AdultDentalServicesWaitingPeriod.definition: An indication of whether an insurance plan has an Adult Dental Services Waiting Period before a service offered under the plan is covered.
AdultDentalServicesWaitingPeriod.comments: This field is not applicable to medical plans.

WaitingPeriodDuration.definition: The Waiting Period duration date of on an insurance plan.
WaitingPeriodDuration.comments: This field is not applicable to medical plans.

PlanEffectiveDate.definition: Beginning date of enrollment coverage on an insurance plan

PlanExpirationDate.definition: Closing date of enrollment coverage on an insurance plan
PlanExpirationDate.comments: This field is optional; blank or zero values indicate a value was not provided.

OutOfCountryCoverage.definition: Indicates whether out of country coverage is provided for health services

OutOfCountryCoverageDescription.definition: The conditions under which out of country health services are covered
OutOfCountryCoverageDescription.comments: This field is only applicable to plans that offer out of country coverage.

OutOfServiceAreaCoverage.definition: Indicates whether out of service area coverage is provided

OutOfServiceAreaCoverageDescription.definition: The conditions under which out of service area health services are covered
OutOfServiceAreaCoverageDescription.comments: This field is only applicable to plans that offer out of service area coverage.

NationalNetwork.definition: Indicates whether the insurance plan is supported by a national network of health service provider companies

URLForEnrollmentPayment.comments: This field is optional; blank or zero values indicate a value was not provided.

FormularyURL.definition: The URL for the prescription drug formulary associated with the plan
FormularyURL.comments: This field is only available for the 2015 through 2027 datasets. This field is only valid for medical plans.

PlanId.definition: Seventeen-character alpha-numeric code that identifies an insurance plan’s cost sharing reduction (CSR) variant within HIOS
PlanId.comments: Prepopulated in template; character count includes ‘-‘

PlanVariantMarketingName.definition: Marketing name of the plan variation of the insurance plan
PlanVariantMarketingName.comments: This field is only available for the 2017 through 2027 datasets.

CSRVariationType.definition: Name of the cost sharing reduction options offered for a health insurance plan

IssuerActuarialValue.definition: The numeric Actuarial Value (AV) generated manually for an insurance plan by the issuer
IssuerActuarialValue.comments: This field is only applicable to plans with a unique plan design.

AVCalculatorOutputNumber.definition: The numeric AV generated by the template’s AV Calculator for an insurance plan
AVCalculatorOutputNumber.comments: This field is only applicable to medical plans and plans that do not have a unique plan design.

MedicalDrugDeductiblesIntegrated.definition: An indication of whether the insurance plan specifies that the medical and drug deductibles are combined into one deductible
MedicalDrugDeductiblesIntegrated.comments: This field is not applicable to dental plans.

MedicalDrugMaximumOutofPocketIntegrated.definition: An indication of whether the insurance plan specifies that the medical and drug maximum out of pocket (MOOP) limits are combined into one limit
MedicalDrugMaximumOutofPocketIntegrated.comments: This field is not applicable to dental plans.

MultipleInNetworkTiers.definition: An indication of whether there are two in network tiers

FirstTierUtilization.definition: The expected percentage of utilization for the first in network tier

SecondTierUtilization.definition: The expected percentage of utilization for the second in network tier, based on the value entered for the first tier

SBCHavingaBabyDeductible.definition: The dollar amount of the deductible for the sample Summary of Benefits & Coverage (SBC) scenario of having a baby
SBCHavingaBabyDeductible.comments: This field is optional; blanks indicate a value was not provided; this field is not applicable to dental plans.

SBCHavingaBabyCopayment.definition: The dollar amount of the copayment for the sample SBC scenario of having a baby

BeginPrimaryCareDeductibleCoinsuranceAft.comments: This field is optional; blank or zero values indicate a value was not provided.

ReasonForBronzeToSilverCrosswalk.definition: Categorical indicator of the reason for bronze to silver crosswalk
ReasonForBronzeToSilverCrosswalk.comments: For the 2027 PUF, a value of X indicates that: a 2027 silver metal level plan is not available for enrollees in a 2026 bronze plan that would be crosswalked to a 2027 bronze plan, but who qualify for bronze to silver metal level re-enrollment; the 2026 plan is not a bronze plan; or the 2026 plan is a bronze plan but it would be crosswalked to a 2027 plan that is another metal level. A similar definition applies to this variable for datasets of previous plan years. This field is only available for the 2024 through 2027 datasets.

SilverCSREligPlanID_2024.definition: Fourteen-character alpha-numeric code that identifies the 2024 silver level plan for enrollees in a 2023 bronze plan who qualify for bronze to silver metal level re-enrollment
SilverCSREligPlanID_2024.comments: A value of “00000XX0000000” indicates that: a 2024 silver metal level plan is not available for enrollees in a 2023 bronze plan who qualify for bronze to silver metal level re-enrollment; the 2023 plan is not a bronze plan; or the 2023 plan is a bronze plan but it would be crosswalked to a 2024 plan at another metal level. This field is only available for the 2024 dataset.

SilverCSREligIssuerID_2025.comments: A value of “00000” indicates that: a 2025 silver metal level plan is not available for enrollees in a 2024 bronze plan who qualify for bronze to silver metal level re-enrollment; the 2024 plan is not a bronze plan; or the 2024 plan is not a bronze plan but it would be crosswalked to a 2025 plan at another metal level.
